title: Neighborhood Metric2 Field Completeness Score
dataSources: Nextdoor posts (`nextdoor:post`), Ring Neighbors alerts (`ring:neighbor`), neighborhood watch logs (`neighborhood:watch`), and local alerts (`local:alert`).
app: Nextdoor post exports, Ring Neighbors alerts, neighborhood watch logs, and local emergency alert feeds ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=neighborhood:metric2
| eval complete=if(isnotnull(value) AND isnotnull(duration_min),1,0)
| stats sum(complete) as complete_rows, count as total
| eval completeness_pct=round(100*complete_rows/total,1)
description: Measures how often neighborhood metric2 (2) events include both value and duration.
value: Incomplete exports break joins and dashboards; completeness scoring catches schema drift early.
implementation: Require `value` and `duration_min` on neighborhood metric2 (2) events and track completeness percentage.
visualization: Single-value gauge of field completeness percent.
grandmaExplanation: It predicts how often your neighborhood metric2 (2) exports arrive with the key numbers filled in.
